items.stem: Which digit can NEVER be the units digit of a perfect square?
Explain in one line why 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 = 25 is not a coincidence.
items.answer: The sum of the first n odd numbers is n²; here n = 5, so the sum is 5² = 25.
items.markingKey: The sum of the first n odd numbers is n²; here n = 5, so the sum is 5² = 25.

items.stem: A student says: 'A number ending in 6 is always a perfect square, because 16 and 36 are.' Give a counter-example and explain what the units-digit rule really tells us.
items.answer: 26 ends in 6 but lies between 25 and 36, so it is not a square. The units-digit rule only rules numbers OUT (ending in 2, 3, 7, 8); it never proves a number IS a square.
items.markingKey: 26 ends in 6 but lies between 25 and 36, so it is not a square. The units-digit rule only rules numbers OUT (ending in 2, 3, 7, 8); it never proves a number IS a square.

How many natural numbers lie between 24² and 25²?
items.answer: 2 × 24 = 48 numbers (between n² and (n+1)² there are 2n numbers).

(i) Write the line that gives 6². (ii) Which odd number must be added to 6² to get 7²? (iii) Use the pattern to show that 13 + 15 = 64 − 36.
items.markingKey: (i) 6 odd numbers ending at 11 (1 mark). (ii) (k + 1)² − k² = 2k + 1 = 13 (1 mark). (iii) adding the next two odd numbers moves from 6² to 8²: 28 = 64 − 36 (2 marks).

items.answer: Every exponent must be even (the primes pair up).

items.stem: Explain why doubling the side of a cube makes its volume 8 times, not 2 times.
items.answer: (2s)³ = 8s³: each of the three dimensions doubles, so the volume multiplies by 2 × 2 × 2.

items.answer: (6, 8, 10) is (3, 4, 5) scaled by 2; 36 + 64 = 100 still holds because every term gets multiplied by 4.

items.stem: Is (5, 12, 13) produced by the formula (2m, m² − 1, m² + 1) for some natural number m? What does this tell you about the formula?
items.answer: No: the even member 12 would give 2m = 12, m = 6, but then m² − 1 = 35 ≠ 5. The formula gives many triplets but not all of them.
items.markingKey: No: the even member 12 would give 2m = 12, m = 6, but then m² − 1 = 35 ≠ 5. The formula gives many triplets but not all of them.
